links.comparator_used: Same Gemma models prompted without structured guideline-based (RECIST/AJCC) reasoning prompts
links.outcome: F1-score on RECIST tumor response and AJCC TNM staging reasoning tasks
links.effect: Gemma 12B with structured reasoning prompts reached F1 of 81.5 (95% CI: 79.8-83.3) for tumor response, 74.3 (70.8-77.8) for T-stage, 87.1 (85.1-89.0) for N-stage and 90.8 (89.1-92.2) for M-stage, described as substantial improvements; Gemma 4B showed inconsistent performance. Baseline F1 values are not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: The 4B model was sometimes degraded under reasoning prompts.
links.quote: In contrast, the 4B model showed inconsistent performance and was sometimes degraded under reasoning prompts.

links.comparator_used: Same Gemma models without structured reasoning prompts
links.outcome: F1-score on RECIST tumor response and TNM staging reasoning tasks
links.effect: Gemma 12B showed substantial improvements with structured reasoning prompts (F1 81.5 tumor response, 74.3 T-stage, 87.1 N-stage, 90.8 M-stage); Gemma 4B performance was inconsistent and sometimes degraded.
links.tradeoff: Reasoning prompts sometimes reduced the performance of the smaller 4B model.
links.quote: Furthermore, when guided by structured reasoning prompts, it also showed substantial improvements in reasoning tasks, achieving an F1-score of 81.5 (95% CI: 79.8-83.3) for tumor response, 74.3 (95% CI: 70.8-77.8) for T-stage, 87.1 (95% CI: 85.1-89.0) for N-stage, and 90.8 (95% CI: 89.1-92.2) for M-stage.
